23
Which statements describe changes that occur from left to right across a period of the Periodic
Table?
1
The atomic number of the elements increases.
2
The metallic character of the elements decreases.
3
The physical state of the elements changes from gas to solid.
A
2 only
B
1 and 2
C
1 and 3
D
2 and 3
subject: Chemistry
